item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meena's mother compares two packaged snacks for a school tiffin. Each label gives values per 100 g. Junk foods are high in calories and fat but low in protein and dietary fibre. Which snack better fits the junk-food pattern?

options.A: Baked soya sticks: 380 kcal, 8 g fat, 20 g protein, 12 g dietary fibre
options.B: Fried banana chips: 540 kcal, 32 g fat, 6 g protein, 5 g dietary fibre
options.C: Roasted peanuts: 400 kcal, 14 g fat, 24 g protein, 9 g dietary fibre
options.D: Sprouted moong mix: 330 kcal, 5 g fat, 19 g protein, 15 g dietary fibre
